staff.name: Lizi Doerffler
staff.description:
✨ Lizi Doerffler - Professional Massage Therapist ✨

With over 5 years of experience, I am dedicated to helping my clients feel better both physically and emotionally through a wide range of massage techniques. I offer therapeutic, relaxing, lymphatic, post-operative, sports massages, and more :  customizing each session to fit your specific needs for maximum well-being.

Whether you're looking to relieve pain, recover from surgery, improve athletic performance, or simply unwind from daily stress, I’m here to help you achieve your health and relaxation goals.

Book your appointment and let me help you feel renewed and revitalized! 🌿✨

IMPORTANT: For my safety, I offer this service to your home only for WOMEN. I'm also in the process of learning English, fluent in Spanish and English

reviews.author: Alexa R…
reviews.body: This is the second time I’ve had a massage with Lizi, and honestly, it’s incredible. I’m getting lymphatic drainage treatments to help with fluid retention, and the change has been amazing right from the very first session... 100% recommended.

reviews.author: Yaydra H…
reviews.body: Lizi was so kind, professional, and gentle throughout my massage. She made me feel comfortable and took her time to ensure I was okay during the entire session. I truly appreciated her care and attention, especially so soon after surgery. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Tania M…
reviews.body: She did an amazing job!! I immediately noticed a difference in my swelling post-op. She’s professional, sweet and takes her time to make sure she makes you feel comfortable. 10/10
